== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Helgard]] [[Incarnation]] is a highly intelligent and articulate being characterized by blue skin, curly white hair, spiral horns, and icy eyes that can emit a blue-green light. As an embodiment of a specific [[Territory]], she possesses significant elemental control, capable of summoning blizzards and using ice to fight independently of her physical movements. She is accompanied by a pack of white, furry creatures and has been seen working alongside a one-eyed [[giant]]. [[Incarnation|The Incarnation]] has successfully entered Ragnarus the Crimson Vault{{!}}Ragnarus, an event that suggests escalating danger. She demonstrates a profound interest in understanding others, claiming she will preserve the memory of those she learns about long after they have died. During combat, she has shown remarkable resilience, such as being able to reattach a severed hand using her ice powers.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|This entity possesses blue skin and curly white hair. Its features include spiral horns and glacial eyes.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Helgard]] [[Incarnation]] is capable of engaging in intelligible conversations. It has been heard speaking with a grating voice.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|This being can create a layer of frost and tear open a Gate amidst swirling red light.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Helgard]] [[Incarnation]] possesses blue skin, curly white hair, spiral horns, and glacial eyes. This entity is capable of intelligible conversation, though it once spoke the word 'Ragnarus the Crimson Vault{{!}}Ragnarus' in a grating voice. While positioned behind [[Zakareth]] at the gates of [[Cana]], the creature demonstrated its power by tearing open a Gate amidst a flash of swirling red light. During a confrontation, [[Simon]]'s blade passed through the entity's wrist, prompting the [[Helgard]] [[Incarnation]] to create a layer of frost.}}
